tolerance.note: 3 percent, fixed before the run, because DWSIM's Raoult's law vapour pressures are not the CoolProp equations of state; the mass balance is exact (0.01 percent)

scenarios.why: self-learning question 2a: the ideal dew pressure at 69 C is 77.03 kPa, so 70 kPa should vaporise the whole feed; the vapour then has the feed composition (independent calculation)
self-learning question 2b: the ideal dew temperature at 1.013 bar is 77.38 C, so 80 C should be fully vapour with the feed composition
the ideal bubble pressure at 69 C is 126.73 kPa, so 140 kPa should leave the feed fully liquid with the feed composition

review.method: independent Rachford-Rice flash with CoolProp vapour pressures; mass balance exact
